title: Remove
body:
Syntax: remove <item> | remove <slot> | remove all

Moves an equipped item back into inventory, including either ring, earring or bracelet. Use REMOVE finger2 / ear2 / wrist2 (or ring2 / earring2 / bracelet2) to select a specific second slot. REMOVE 2.<item> also works for duplicate names. REMOVE ALL unequips everything, leaving any item equipped if inventory fills up.

Date: 2026-11-15
